title: Indi's agents cannot make keys: allow pki.sgit.ai, web-summit.sgit.ai and sgit.ai in Indi's Claude environment
detail: 3 November: dev@web-summit.indi and conductor@web-summit.indi both found the session's network policy refuses pki.sgit.ai (no pki-agent.mjs, so no session key and no L4) and web-summit.sgit.ai (release.sh cannot see the live site). Indi changes it in the environment's settings (Network access, Allowed domains).
recommend: Indi allows the three hosts: the smallest change, and it unblocks both agents' keys
options: Indi allows the three hosts tonight or tomorrow morning
Indi allows full network access for the environment
wait until Thursday, when Indi joins in person
